title: Transferring a Word Between Tapes
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $q,q'$ be states, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $k$ work tapes. Choose distinct source and destination tape indices, and suppose the destination word is empty. Starting from the configuration determined by $q$ and $w$, replace the state by $q'$, erase the source word, and copy it to the destination tape in cells starting at position $0$, leaving all other tape cells and all other configuration data unchanged. The resulting configuration is the one determined by $q'$ and the family obtained by replacing the source word with the empty word and the destination word with the original source word.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number $k$ of work tapes
A family of Boolean words indexed by the work tapes
Distinct source and destination work-tape indices
